newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha market thin, holds steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha market thin, holds steady to firm.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady in very thin activity.
"Crude has been all over the place, but naphtha has been very quiet," said one trader.
"There's little buying interest, but then again there is not much selling interest," said another. A Russian parcel was understood to be on offer.
Talk on January swaps has almost been exhausted while February attracted only modest interest with numbers pegged around $220 cif NWE for much of the day.
